data.summary: At 51,093,191 views and a 1.0% like-to-view ratio, “Why did he do that?😔💔” is resonating as a ASMR; the strongest likely driver is velocity. Treat each factor below as a hypothesis grounded in the public data — not a guarantee.

why_trending.detail: Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
A tight, fast cold-open with the payoff up front likely sustains the watch-through that Shorts distribution favors.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
